details.name: Kimi K3
details.meta: 2026.07 Release · Moonshot AI · 2.8T MoE Colossus · KDA Attention
details.desc: Moonshot AI's flagship 2.8-Trillion parameter model (104B active) released with open weights. Powered by novel Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), it drastically lowers KV cache memory while maintaining a pristine 1M token context window. Debuting with 1512 Elo on LMSYS Chatbot Arena, Kimi K3 rivals Western Tier-1 models in long-horizon reasoning and native multimodal comprehension.

details.name: GLM-5.3
details.meta: 2026.08 Release · Zhipu AI (Z.ai) · Agentic Environment Scaling Pioneer
details.desc: Zhipu AI's breakthrough 2026 flagship. Moving beyond raw parameter scaling, GLM-5.3 is the benchmark pioneer of 'Environment Scaling' post-training, learning through autonomous interaction across tens of thousands of sandboxes and bash environments. It ranks #1 globally on Terminal-Bench 3.0 and CyberGym vulnerability discovery, setting the gold standard for reliable autonomous agent execution.

details.name: DeepSeek-V4-Pro
details.meta: 2026.08 Release · Open Weights / 1.6T MoE · Industrial Open-Source Frontier
details.desc: DeepSeek's 1.6 Trillion parameter MoE (49B active) released with open weights. The 0813 revision achieved 80.6%-95.2% on SWE-bench Verified, delivering parity with top-tier proprietary models at unprecedented cost efficiency.

details.name: Claude Fable 5.1
details.meta: 2026.09 Release · Anthropic Proprietary · Autonomous Agentic Pioneer
details.desc: Anthropic's September 2026 flagship, leading both Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (66) and LMSYS Arena (1520 Elo). Pioneering advanced autonomous agentic planning, multi-file code refactoring, and self-correction protocols.

details.name: GPT-6 Astra
details.meta: 2026.09 Release · OpenAI Proprietary · Long-Horizon Autonomous Reasoning
details.desc: OpenAI's breakthrough Autumn 2026 flagship model. Dominates Olympiad-level mathematics and multi-agent game-theoretic planning, featuring full self-directed execution with robust safety and alignment guardrails.

details.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
details.desc: Google's ultra-low latency model engineered for interactive and agentic microservices. Features 240+ t/s throughput and sub-120ms time-to-first-token across a native 2-million token multimodal context window.

projects.heroDesc: Spanning governed local-first agent operating systems, high-concurrency enterprise recruitment backends, ML resume scoring engines, and high-throughput inference runtimes.
projects.comingDesc: Currently developing a multi-agent orchestrated workflow automation platform. Stay tuned for open-source releases and online demos.
projects.p1_desc: A full-featured open-source local coding agent CLI, engineered as an open alternative to Claude Code. Implements plan, review, and build execution modes with a decoupled agent runtime managing state loops, task traces, and dynamic execution. Features native SDK integrations for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI-compatible upstreams (vLLM/Ollama); ships with 39+ workspace tools, prompt-activated Skills, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) remote server extensibility.
projects.p2_desc: Full-cycle commercial product: An e-commerce and generative platform for personalized 3D-printed figurines and custom art gifts. Architected the core AI image generation pipeline, orchestrating multi-stage workflows via ComfyUI (text-to-image, LoRA style adaptation, ControlNet pose/geometry conditioning, and facial identity preservation). Built high-concurrency Java backend task queues and GPU cluster dispatching to deliver industrial-grade assets for 3D manufacturing.
projects.p3_title: ⚡ Nobita Talks AI (Static Site Engine & Architecture)
projects.p3_desc: The open-source production codebase powering this bilingual AI systems engineering hub. Engineered on a custom Vite, Handlebars, and Marked build pipeline featuring native KaTeX mathematical typography and syntax highlighting. Ships with zero-overhead client-side inverted search indexing, automated dynamic SVG OpenGraph generation, Schema.org (TechArticle & FAQPage) JSON-LD injection, and automated IndexNow protocol submission in CI with strict smoke test suites.
projects.p4_title: 👁️ Edge-AI Vision System (Edge Real-time Vision Engine)
projects.p4_desc: A high-performance real-time object detection and multi-target tracking system engineered for resource-constrained edge computing hardware (NVIDIA Jetson / ARM NPU). Features YOLO architecture optimization in PyTorch, TensorRT INT8 / FP16 quantization with kernel fusion, and zero-copy OpenCV hardware video stream decoding. Integrates ByteTrack multi-object tracking to deliver sub-millisecond inference and reliable edge-to-cloud telemetry synchronization.
projects.p5_title: 🏢 Smart Campus AI (Video Stream Intelligence & IoT Dispatch)
projects.p5_desc: An enterprise end-to-end multi-channel video analytics and IoT automated dispatch system. Built with an asynchronous Python microservices architecture and distributed event buses to handle high-throughput RTSP/RTMP IP camera stream ingestion, adaptive hardware decoding, and asynchronous inference queues. Powers perimeter intrusion alerts, crowd density estimation, and anomaly detection, triggering real-time WebSocket notifications, snapshot archiving, and multi-channel incident dispatches.
projects.p6_desc: An open-source interactive data analysis platform powered by an autonomous agent. Moving beyond static DAG pipelines, it employs dynamic tool-calling and self-directed planning to analyze tabular datasets (CSV/Excel uploads or PostgreSQL/MySQL bounded snapshots). The agent autonomously explores schemas, executes sandboxed Python/SQL code, generates interactive ECharts visualizations, and synthesizes structured analytical reports. Built on Go, Vue 3, and isolated Docker execution containers.
projects.navi_desc: Personal open-source flagship project: A local-first, governed personal AI assistant Agent OS. Powered by declarative schema-validated capability manifests for task planning, durable Goal/Run state machines, scoped typed memory with conflict resolution, and Linux Bubblewrap (bwrap) sandbox isolation. Shipped with CLI, authenticated local FastAPI services, and native WeChat & Telegram connectors.
projects.nowcoder_title: 🏢 Nowcoder Enterprise Recruitment & AI Resume Scoring
projects.nowcoder_desc: Core engineering for a commercial B2B recruitment & talent acquisition platform. Developed enterprise backend services using Java / Spring Boot microservices and high-concurrency database designs, supporting massive enterprise job postings, candidate pipelines, and complex RBAC. Designed and deployed an AI resume scoring & matching system based on Python scikit-learn (sklearn) Support Vector Machine (SVM) and multidimensional text feature engineering.
projects.maas_title: ⚡ Heterogeneous MaaS Platform (K8s + GPUStack Serving Cluster)
projects.maas_desc: An enterprise Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) computing substrate engineered for large-scale LLM deployment. Built on Kubernetes (K8s) and GPUStack to virtualize and schedule heterogeneous compute clusters. Deep operational mastery in multi-chip unified model serving across NVIDIA (A800 / H800), Huawei Ascend (910B / 310P NPUs), and Iluvatar (PPU 810E) accelerators; tuned vLLM and MindIE runtime kernels, weight distribution caching, dynamic batching, and multi-tenant resilient routing.
